scope: Documentation Site UI Polish: Purge Diagnostic Callouts, Restore Sidebar Header Branding, Mobile Filmstrip Collapsible Drawer, Tag Simplification, and Card Containment

tasks.title: Remove Edge Cases and OpenXML Impact Callout Boxes
tasks.description: In docs-site/src/components/ApiReferenceCard.jsx and PowerPointSlideDeck components, remove the 'Edge Cases' and 'OpenXML Impact' callout containers/boxes from the slide presentation view. Ensure that removing these sections leaves clean spacing and maximizes vertical breathing room for method descriptions, parameter tables, and code snippets without altering the core documentation copy.

tasks.title: Fix SlideThumbnailSidebar Header Title to Display 'API Reference'
tasks.description: In docs-site/src/components/PowerPointChrome/SlideThumbnailSidebar.jsx, fix the sidebar header title rendering. It currently mirrors or duplicates the active category name; update it to permanently display 'API Reference' as the top structural section title, keeping the category and filter indicators secondary.

tasks.title: Implement Expandable/Collapsible Mobile Slide Filmstrip
tasks.description: In docs-site/src/components/PowerPointChrome/MobileSlideFilmstrip.jsx (and related mobile navigation bars), make the bottom slide filmstrip drawer collapsible: clicking or tapping on the toggle/header expands the horizontal filmstrip tray, and tapping it again collapses it to a minimal, non-intrusive bottom bar to free up viewport space for reading slide function details.

tasks.title: Remove 'static' and 'async' Tags from Method Badges
tasks.description: In docs-site/src/components/ApiReferenceCard.jsx and docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json rendering logic, remove standalone 'static' and 'async' pill badges from the method header. Ensure asynchronous invocation is clearly shown through the code signature (e.g., using 'await ppt.method(...)') rather than cluttering the header with redundant static/async tags.

tasks.title: Enforce Strict Card Boundaries for Function Sidebar and Details View
tasks.description: Fix CSS layout constraints in docs-site/src/components/ApiReferenceCard.jsx and docs-site/src/components/PowerPointSlideDeck.jsx to prevent inner submenus, function lists, or Function Details cards from overflowing outside the slide card boundaries. Apply strict containment (`overflow-hidden`, `max-w-full`, inner `overflow-y-auto` with clean scroll padding) so all function listings and parameter details remain strictly within the parent PowerPoint presentation slide frame.
